UPSC_CSE.title: UPSC CSE
UPSC_CSE.eligibility: Graduate from any recognized University. Age: 21-32 years (General)
UPSC_CSE.overview: Joining the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) or Indian Police Service (IPS) is the dream of lakhs of graduates. The Civil Services Examination conducted by UPSC is the pathway to these prestigious roles. To succeed, you need to prepare for three distinct stages: Prelims, Mains, and the Interview. The preliminary stage tests your general knowledge and basic aptitude. The mains stage consists of nine descriptive papers that require deep writing practice. Finally, the personality test checks your communication and confidence. Aspirants usually spend two to three years of intense study for this exam. You must study subjects like History, Geography, Economics, and Polity in great depth. Keeping track of current affairs is also very important. Tracking your daily progress across this massive syllabus is crucial. This page organizes all topics subject-wise to help you cover the syllabus systematically.
